name: The Horn
source_note: Brussels architectural heritage inventory entry 31123 lists reconstruction in 1697; the city dataset gives the broader range 1697–1704. This is an official reconstruction-date proxy, not a structured original-construction year; human review still required.
city_history: Reconstruction in 1697-1704 of the house with a stone façade from 1641 (Architect Antoon Pastorana). Restoration in 1885-1902; refurbishment of the upper parts in 1987-1990, and most recent restoration by the City completed in 2015.

name: The  Weighing  Scales
source_note: Brussels architectural heritage inventory entry 30991 (La Balance, Rue de la Colline 24) lists 1704, agreeing with the city history text. This is an official reconstruction-date proxy, not a structured original-construction year; human review still required.
city_history: Reconstruction in 1704 on the preserved cellars. Restorations in 1890 and 1986; most recent intervention in 2000 with complete reconstruction of the rear façade, following its collapse.
identity_note: The City dataset labels this case The Weighing Scales, Grand-Place 24. Heritage inventory Urban 30991 labels La Balance, Rue de la Colline 24, while explicitly treating its facade as part of the Grand-Place ensemble. The British Library caption uses rue de la Colline; Wikimedia Commons describes Grand-Place and supplies protected-monument identifier 2043-0177/0. The City and heritage records share the distinctive 1704, 1890 and 1986 chronology, but the street-address mapping still requires reviewer confirmation.
